description: Defines the H264Decoder class and its nested H264Accelerator interface for hardware-accelerated H264 video decoding, including methods for processing SPS/PPS, slices, decoding, and output management.

classes.name: media::H264Decoder
classes.description: A class for hardware-accelerated decoding of H264 video streams, managing stream processing, decoding, and output.

classes.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator
classes.description: Interface for hardware-specific acceleration operations required during H264 decoding, such as picture creation, SPS/PPS processing, slice submission, and decoding execution.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::H264Accelerator
methods.description: Constructor for the H264Accelerator interface.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::~H264Accelerator
methods.description: Destructor for the H264Accelerator interface.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::CreateH264Picture
methods.description: Creates a new H264 picture object for decoding.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::ProcessSPS
methods.description: Provides SPS data to the accelerator.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::ProcessPPS
methods.description: Provides PPS data to the accelerator.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits frame metadata including SPS, PPS, DPB, and reference pictures.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::ParseEncryptedSliceHeader
methods.description: Parses encrypted slice headers for CENCv1 streams.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::SubmitSlice
methods.description: Submits a slice of a frame for decoding.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::SubmitDecode
methods.description: Executes hardware decode for a picture.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::OutputPicture
methods.description: Schedules output of a decoded picture.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::Reset
methods.description: Resets the accelerator state.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::H264Accelerator::SetStream
methods.description: Sets a new stream for decoding, with optional decryption config.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder
methods.description: Main class for managing hardware-accelerated H264 decoding, including stream setting, decoding, resetting, and output.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::SetStream
methods.description: Sets the input stream and decoder buffer.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::Flush
methods.description: Flushes the decoder.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::Decode
methods.description: Performs decoding of the current stream.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetPicSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the decoded picture.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetVisibleRect
methods.description: Returns the visible rectangle of the decoded picture.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetProfile
methods.description: Returns the profile of the input stream.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetBitDepth
methods.description: Returns the bit depth of the input stream.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetChromaSampling
methods.description: Returns the chroma sampling format.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetHDRMetadata
methods.description: Returns HDR metadata if available.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetRequiredNumOfPictures
methods.description: Returns the number of pictures required for decoding.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::GetNumReferenceFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of reference frames.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::IsNewPrimaryCodedPicture
methods.description: Determines if the current picture starts a new primary coded picture.

methods.name: media::H264Decoder::FillH264PictureFromSliceHeader
methods.description: Fills an H264Picture object from a slice header.
